Volvo B9TL Wright Eclipse Gemini: Mid-2000s double-decker with a curved front and spacious low-floor interior; a long-serving UK workhorse.
Scania N280UD ADL Enviro400 City CBG: Compressed-biogas double-decker with a 280 bhp Scania engine; quieter and lower-emission than a diesel equivalent.
ADL Enviro400 MMC: The 2014 Major Model Change double-decker; offered with diesel, gas, hybrid and electric powertrains.
Yutong U11DD: Battery-electric double-decker built for the UK, with a 220 kW motor and a range close to 500 km.
Wright StreetDeck Ultroliner: Wrightbus integral double-decker using micro-hybrid braking-energy recovery to reduce diesel consumption.
ADL Enviro400: Original 2005-2018 low-floor double-decker that set the pattern later refined by the Enviro400 MMC.
Scania N250UD ADL Enviro400 MMC: Scania 250 bhp chassis with Enviro400 MMC body; some examples have tables and coach-style interiors.
ADL Enviro200 MMC: Compact 2014-on single-decker, built in several lengths and powertrains; some examples joined autonomous-bus trials.
Volvo B7RLE Wright Eclipse 2: 2008 single-decker with updated Wrightbus styling on Volvo's low-entry B7RLE chassis.
Wright StreetLite DF: Compact door-forward midibus introduced in 2010, seating roughly 33-45 passengers and known for vibration.
ADL Enviro200: First-generation 2003-2018 midibus that replaced the Dennis Dart SLF, sold in several lengths and engine outputs.
Volvo B7RLE Wright Eclipse Urban: Early-2000s Wrightbus single-decker on Volvo's B7RLE chassis; a dependable low-entry workhorse.
Volvo B9TL Wright Eclipse Gemini 2: 2008 double-decker refresh with new front and rear panels, also offered on hybrid Volvo chassis.
Optare Solo SR: Small low-floor midibus with curved side glazing, offered in diesel, hybrid and electric forms.
Yutong E12: Chinese-built 12-metre electric single-decker with a 215 kW motor, air suspension and about 39 seats.
ADL Enviro400 City: Premium-styled double-decker launched in 2015, distinguished by its restyled front and glass staircase.
Volvo B9R Plaxton Panther: High-floor touring coach seating roughly 53 passengers and designed for long-distance express work.
Volvo B7TL Wright Eclipse Gemini: First-generation 2001 Gemini double-decker with a low-floor layout and sweeping front end.
VDL DB300 Wright Gemini 2 HEV: Rare early diesel-electric hybrid double-decker; only a small number were built for trials in 2007-08.
Wright StreetDeck Electroliner: Battery-electric double-decker with a 454 kWh battery, rapid charging and up to 200 miles of range.
Wright StreetDeck NewPower EV: A diesel StreetDeck converted to battery-electric power, reusing most of the original chassis and body.
ADL Enviro100EV: Tiny 8.5-metre battery-electric midibus launched in 2024, carrying up to about 45 passengers.
Yutong E9L: Narrow 9.5-metre electric midibus with a 120 kW motor, suited to tight urban and rural routes.
Mercedes-Benz Tourismo: Long-running high-deck touring coach family built for interurban and long-distance work.
Yutong GT12: 12.2-metre diesel coach with a 450 bhp DAF engine, 53 seats and USB charging throughout.
Scania N230UD OmniCity: Integral double-decker introduced in 2006 with a 230 bhp nine-litre engine and an optional ethanol version.
Scania CN230UD OmniCity: Polish-assembled sibling of the N230UD OmniCity, using the same body, 230 bhp engine and gearbox.
Volvo B5TL MCV EvoSeti: Lightweight Euro 6 double-decker launched around 2015, roughly one tonne lighter than its predecessor.
ADL Enviro200EV: Battery-electric single-decker version of ADL's Enviro200 family, designed for efficient urban bus work.
ADL/TransBus Enviro300: Full-size diesel single-decker introduced by TransBus and continued by Alexander Dennis alongside the smaller Enviro200.
Ayats Bravo 1R City: Open-top double-decker designed for city sightseeing, with a low-floor layout and a roofless upper deck.
Mercedes-Benz Sprinter City 45: Compact low-floor diesel city minibus based on the Mercedes-Benz Sprinter van platform.
Optare Solo: Compact low-floor British midibus introduced in the late 1990s, designed for routes needing a smaller vehicle.
Scania K230UB ADL Enviro300: Diesel single-decker combining Scania's K230UB chassis with Alexander Dennis Enviro300 bodywork.
Scania K410EB6 Caetano Levante 3: Long three-axle express coach developed by Caetano for National Express on Scania's 410 hp chassis.
Scania N230UD ADL Enviro400: Diesel double-decker combining Scania's N230UD chassis with Alexander Dennis Enviro400 bodywork.
VDL Futura FHD2: High-deck touring coach offered in several lengths, with substantial underfloor luggage space for long-distance work.
VDL SDD141 Synergy: Large double-deck touring coach designed to carry high passenger numbers on long-distance services.
Van Hool TD921 Altano: Large high-floor diesel touring coach from Van Hool's T9 family, built for long-distance work.
Van Hool TDX25 Astromega: Double-deck touring coach from Van Hool's TX range, combining high capacity with long-distance accommodation.
Volvo B11R Jonckheere JHV2: High-floor touring coach pairing Volvo's 11-litre B11R chassis with Jonckheere bodywork.
Volvo B11RLET Plaxton Panorama: Three-axle low-entry double-deck coach with a flat lower saloon and high passenger capacity.
Volvo B5TL UNVI Urbis 2.5 DD: Lightweight Volvo five-litre double-deck chassis with Spanish-built UNVI Urbis bodywork.
Volvo B9TL Optare Visionaire: Open-top sightseeing double-decker combining Volvo's B9TL chassis with Optare Visionaire bodywork.
Volvo B9TL UNVI Urbis 2.5 DD: Volvo B9TL diesel double-deck chassis with Spanish-built UNVI Urbis bodywork, often used for sightseeing.
Yutong E10: Ten-metre battery-electric city bus developed for urban work, including right-hand-drive UK operation.
